run_celestial_to_euclidean: convert right ascension and declination coordinates to 3D Euclidean x, y, z coordinates
run_euclidean_to_celestial: convert 3D Euclidean x, y, z coordinates back to right ascension and declination
run_euclidean_to_celestial_th: convert PyTorch tensor Euclidean coordinates to celestial right ascension and declination
run_sphere_dist_th: compute the great circle distance between two points on a unit sphere using PyTorch
run_c_convex: create a c-convex function on the sphere with random components and evaluate it at given points
